EACH BUCKET IS A HARD STOP: once used up, that step makes no more LLM calls. The overall cap is the backstop. Spare answers move to another bucket only with the user's approval file (load-tests/llm_budget.py transfer); nothing rolls over automatically. This file is the pinned source of bucket sizes read by load-tests/llm_budget.py and load-tests/loadgen.py; the ledger records the sha256 of this file when it is created. The cost per answer (USD 0.001365) is an estimate from load-tests/config/load-profile.v1.json, not metered; the Anthropic console, the Voyage console and the AWS bill are the costs of record, reported as separate items and then combined.
